verdicts.reason: The quote only says a CSR is not required and configuration is static. That is a scope statement. It is not a prohibition on the bridge, and there is nothing to verify or exercise.
'No CSR workbook is required' is a documentation or deliverable statement. It sets no hardware behaviour, so there is nothing to verify.

The quote says SoC integration configures the address map and default error Completer. That describes an integration responsibility and is not a bridge behaviour. The system actor has nothing checkable, and the second half of the quote (no software sequence applies) does not support the rule.
